name: gitstack
description: Use focused Git and GitHub workflows to create commits, manage issues and reviews, diagnose Actions failures, publish releases, and open draft pull requests.

interface.longDescription: GitStack provides focused workflows for Git commits, GitHub issues, single- and multi-repository triage, technical investigations, pull request review threads, Actions failures, releases, stars, and draft pull request publication. It uses direct git for local work, the GitHub connector for supported remote operations, and gh only for connector gaps.
defaultPrompt: Triage this repository's open issues and pull requests.
Diagnose and fix the failing GitHub Actions checks.
Publish these local changes as a safe draft pull request.
